name: Internal SSH Authentication Failure Burst
description: Detects repeated failed SSH authentication from a source against a host and username within a ten-minute window. This is a threshold analytic for password guessing; it does not prove a successful login or compromise.
note:
## Triage and analysis

Investigate the source host, target host, username, authentication method, and adjacent successful logins. Exclude only approved administrative jump hosts or authorized scanners after validation. A match indicates repeated failed authentication, not successful access.

This rule is intentionally generic and does not hardcode any source IP.
author: SOC Analyst
false_positives: Authorized vulnerability scanners, penetration tests, administrators testing credentials, and misconfigured automation may generate repeated failures.
query: event.dataset:"system.auth" and event.action:"ssh_login" and event.outcome:"failure" and source.ip:* and user.name:*
